verses.1: The point of what we are saying is this: We do have such a high priest, who sat down at the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in heaven,
verses.2: and who ministers in the sanctuary and true tabernacle set up by the Lord, not by man.
verses.3: And since every high priest is appointed to offer both gifts and sacrifices, it was necessary for this One also to have something to offer.
verses.4: Now if He were on earth, He would not be a priest, since there are already priests who offer gifts according to the law.
verses.5:
The place where they serve is a copy and shadow of what is in heaven. This is why Moses was warned when he was about to build the tabernacle: “See to it that you make everything according to the pattern shown you on the mountain.” + 8:5 Exodus 25:40|EXO 25:40 ; see also Exodus 26:30. 
 The New Covenant
 ( Jeremiah 31:26–40|JER 31:26-40 )
verses.6: Now, however, Jesus has received a much more excellent ministry, just as the covenant He mediates is better and is founded on better promises.
verses.7: For if that first covenant had been without fault, no place would have been sought for a second.
verses.8:
But God found fault with the people and said:
 “Behold, the days are coming, declares the Lord,
 when I will make a new covenant
 with the house of Israel
 and with the house of Judah.
verses.9:
It will not be like the covenant
 I made with their fathers
 when I took them by the hand
 to lead them out of the land of Egypt,
 because they did not abide by My covenant,
 and I disregarded them,
 declares the Lord.
verses.10:
For this is the covenant I will make
 with the house of Israel
 after those days,
 declares the Lord.
 I will put My laws in their minds
 and inscribe them on their hearts.
 And I will be their God,
 and they will be My people.
verses.11:
No longer will each one teach his neighbor or his brother,
 saying, ‘Know the Lord,’
 because they will all know Me,
 from the least of them to the greatest.
verses.12:
For I will forgive their iniquities
 and will remember their sins no more.” + 8:12 Jeremiah 31:31–34|JER 31:31-34 (see also LXX)
verses.13: By speaking of a new covenant, + 8:13 Literally In saying new ; here and in Hebrews 9:1|HEB 9:1 and 18, covenant is included for clarity but is not contained in the Greek. A broader interpretation could also include priesthood or tabernacle . He has made the first one obsolete; and what is obsolete and aging will soon disappear.
